description: This PHP source file is part of the vtiger CRM project, specifically handling the listing of notification schedulers within the Settings module. It retrieves notification scheduler data from the database and displays it using Smarty templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper class used for rendering the CRM's HTML templates.

methods.description: Method called on Smarty object to render specified template.
